title: PRESIDENT OF INDIA TO VISIT HIMACHAL PRADESH FROM OCTOBER 6 TO 8
body_text:
The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu will visit Himachal Pradesh from October 6 to 8, 2026.
On October 6, the President will grace the first convocation of AIIMS Bilaspur in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh.
On October 7, the President will visit Atal Tunnel, Rohtang, Lahaul – Spiti district.
